facts.fact: 四人跌出 DarkVeil 回到地表，斯巴达人半圆围立——八十一年来无人能进能出，他们看四人的眼神像看传说。
facts.anchor: We’d gone in. We’d come out. For eighty-one years, no one had done that.

facts.fact: 真正让她不安的不是干呕：站在地狱火峡谷边面对冷铁霹雳，她一点不怕，只觉得活着。
facts.anchor: What unnerved me wasn’t the nausea. It was that I hadn’t been afraid.

facts.fact: 那份熟悉感不属于她：体内的 demon passenger 感应 DarkVeil，如囚徒嗅到多年未见的空气；被问「你是什么」时它沉默，那沉默有分量，像悲伤。
facts.anchor: My demon passenger had felt the DarkVeil the way a prisoner feels fresh air after years in a cage.

facts.fact: 寄居体下令：在她准备好之前不得再进 DarkVeil——它向来只护自己的利益，却精于算计，她不敢不听。
facts.anchor: You shall not enter the DarkVeil again, girl. Not before you’re ready.

facts.fact: 她汇报核心情报：DarkVeil 内藏巨量有知觉金属，规模是 Crimson Ridge 的数百倍——这就是无人能活着穿越的原因。
facts.anchor: The DarkVeil contains a vast deposit of the sentient metal. Hundreds of times more than Crimson Ridge.

facts.fact: 她披露第二个能号令冷铁的存在：冷铁称其为 False Heir，靠残暴意志强迫金属服从，那支箭即出自他手。
facts.anchor: There’s an heir who can command Coldiron as well.

facts.fact: Caspian 当场表态：她的位置在他们身边，Missy 由他们一起救回。
facts.anchor: “Your place is with us, Max,” Caspian said, his voice fierce. “And we will get Missy back to you.”

facts.fact: Drakken 坚持军纪：不准无许可擅自行动、不准再独自闯未知险境——溺爱只会害死她；与 Caspian 当面对撞，Aelindor 一句话压停。
facts.anchor: “Coddling her will only get her killed,” Drakken snapped, not backing down an inch.

facts.fact: 章末地动不是矿难的塌方，而是暴力——某种攻击正在发生。
